JUDGEMENT

This is a charge sheet filed by the PSI of Bandepalya police police station against the accused No.1 to 3 for the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC.
02.
It is the case of the prosecution that, the marriage between accused no.1 and CW.1 solemnized on 09.12.2018.
After the marriage some days the accused No.1 lead happy life with CW.1.

Thereafter the accused used to quarrel with CW.1 for silly reasons and body shaming and the accused abused CW.1 in filthy language and assaulted her with hands and kicked with his legs and caused C.C.No.
38615/2022 simple injuries for the reason that, their child thrown out the powder on the floor of the house.

Further, accused No.2 & 3 used to abuse CW.1 by saying that, she is unable to do the house work properly , they caused mental and physical cruelty and thus the accused persons have committed the offence.
03. After filing of charge sheet, this court took cognizance for the offences punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC and issued summons to the accused persons.
Accordingly the accused persons appeared before the court through their counsel and enlarged on bail.

Later on, charge sheet copies and prosecution papers were furnished to the accused persons under Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
04.
Heard both side on framing of charge, perused the prosecution papers.
As there are sufficient materials to frame the charge against the accused persons, the charges has been framed and the same were read over to them, but they pleaded not guilty and claimed for trial.
Hence the case was posted for prosecution evidence.
05. In furtherance of the charges leveled against the accused, the following points are arisen for my consideration.

sentences.text: Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the marriage between accused no.1 and CW.1 solemnized on 09.12.2018.
After the marriage some days the accused No.1 lead happy life with CW.1.

Thereafter the accused used to quarrel with CW.1 for silly reasons and body shaming and the accused abused CW.1 in filthy language and assaulted her with hands and kicked with his legs and caused simple injuries for the reason that, their child thrown out the powder on the floor of the house.

Further, accused No.2 & 3 used to abuse CW.1 by saying that, she is unable to do the house work properly , they caused mental and physical cruelty and thus the accused persons have committed the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC. ?
02. What order or Sentence ?
06.
In order to prove the case, the prosecution has examined CW.1 as PW.1 and got marked the documents as per Ex.P1 & Ex.P2.

On consideration of the hostile evidence of PW1, I felt that, no purpose will be served on examination of other witnesses i.e. CW.2 to 15 and rejected the prayer of learned Sr.A.P.P for further evidence and got closed the evidence of prosecution and the accused statement U/sec.313 of Cr.P.C is dispensed with as there are no C.C.No. 38615/2022 incriminating evidence appeared against him and posted the case for arguments.
07. Heard the arguments.
My findings on the above said points are as follows:-
Point No.1 : In the negative.

Point No.2: As per final order, for the following:
REASONS 08. POINT No.1 :- The prosecution has been launched on the basis of complaint lodged by the CW1 for the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC and investigation was taken place on the allegation made by the complainant/CW1 as per the contents of the complaint/Ex.P1.
To prove the case, prosecution has examined CW- 1 as PW-1 who is the informant,
She deposed that, the accused No.1 is her husband and the accused persons never caused any quarrel with her, not assaulted her and abused her in filthy language.
She has deposed that, due to some minor differences with the accused persons and in this regard she has gone to the police station.
Then the police have obtained her signature to the complaint and mahazar Ex. P 1 and P 2.
She has deposed that, now she has compromised the dispute with the accused.
Though the CW.1 identified his C.C.No. 38615/2022 signature on Ex.P.1 and 2, she has deposed that she did not know the contents of Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2.
Further, she has specifically deposed that, the police have not seized any property in her presence.
The PW.1 being the victim has also not deposed about the quarrel or injury caused by accused.
The PW.1 completely turned hostile.

The learned Sr.APP has treated the PW.1 as a hostile witness and cross-examined her by suggesting the case of the prosecution, but nothing worth evidence has been elicited from her to support the case of the prosecution.
She has specifically deposed that, she has compromised the dispute with the accused persons.

09. Here it is pertinent to note that, PW.1 has not at all deposed regarding any of the allegations or incident as appeared in the contents of the complaint and Charge-Sheet and nothing has been elicited from their mouth during her cross-examination done by the prosecution.

Then, the doubt Bandepalya Police Station vs Mahammed Siddiq on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44893430/
3 arises in the mind of the Court regarding the case of the prosecution to bring home the guilt of the accused persons.

sentences.text: Thus, there are no any incriminating materials to establish the alleged offences leveled against the accused persons.
Therefore, the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the alleged offences against the accused beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answered the Point No.1 in the negative.

In view of reasons stated above on points No.1, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
By exercising powers conferred U/sec. 248(1) of Cr.P.C., the accused No.1 to 3 are acquitted for the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC.

The bail bond and surety bond of the accused No.1 to 3 shall continue in force for a period of 6 months for the purposes of section 437(A) of Cr.P.C.
The accused No.1 to 3 are set at liberty.
Further, the property mentioned in PF.No.94/2022 steel sambar spoon is being worthless to be destroyed after completion of appeal period.
